en.text: The second lot came out for Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families. Their inheritance was in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Judah.

zhSimplified.text: 为西缅支派的人，按着宗族，拈出第二阄。他们所得的地业是在犹大人地业中间。

zhTraditional.text: 為西緬支派的人，按着宗族，拈出第二鬮。他們所得的地業是在猶大人地業中間。

en.text: They had for their inheritance Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,

zhSimplified.text: 他们所得为业之地就是：别是巴（或名示巴）、摩拉大、

zhTraditional.text: 他們所得為業之地就是：別是巴（或名示巴）、摩拉大、

en.text: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,

zhSimplified.text: 哈萨·书亚、巴拉、以森、

zhTraditional.text: 哈薩‧書亞、巴拉、以森、

en.text: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,

zhSimplified.text: 伊利多拉、比土力、何珥玛、

zhTraditional.text: 伊利多拉、比土力、何珥瑪、

en.text: Ziklag, Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susah,

zhSimplified.text: 洗革拉、伯·玛加博、哈萨·苏撒、

zhTraditional.text: 洗革拉、伯‧瑪加博、哈薩‧蘇撒、

en.text: Beth Lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities with their villages;

zhSimplified.text: 伯·利巴勿、沙鲁险，共十三座城，还有属城的村庄；

zhTraditional.text: 伯‧利巴勿、沙魯險，共十三座城，還有屬城的村莊；

en.text: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan; four cities with their villages;

zhSimplified.text: 又有亚因、利门、以帖、亚珊，共四座城，还有属城的村庄；

zhTraditional.text: 又有亞因、利門、以帖、亞珊，共四座城，還有屬城的村莊；

en.text: and all the villages that were around these cities to Baalath Beer, Ramah of the South. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.

zhSimplified.text: 并有这些城邑四围一切的村庄，直到巴拉·比珥，就是南地的拉玛。这是西缅支派按着宗族所得的地业。

zhTraditional.text: 並有這些城邑四圍一切的村莊，直到巴拉‧比珥，就是南地的拉瑪。這是西緬支派按着宗族所得的地業。

en.text: Out of the part of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon; for the portion of the children of Judah was too much for them. Therefore the children of Simeon had inheritance in the middle of their inheritance.

zhSimplified.text: 西缅人的地业是从犹大人地业中得来的；因为犹大人的分过多，所以西缅人在他们的地业中得了地业。

zhTraditional.text: 西緬人的地業是從猶大人地業中得來的；因為猶大人的分過多，所以西緬人在他們的地業中得了地業。

en.text: The third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families. The border of their inheritance was to Sarid.

zhSimplified.text: 为西布伦人，按着宗族，拈出第三阄。他们地业的境界是到撒立；

zhTraditional.text: 為西布倫人，按着宗族，拈出第三鬮。他們地業的境界是到撒立；

en.text: Their border went up westward, even to Maralah, and reached to Dabbesheth. It reached to the brook that is before Jokneam.

zhSimplified.text: 往西上到玛拉拉，达到大巴设，又达到约念前的河；

zhTraditional.text: 往西上到瑪拉拉，達到大巴設，又達到約念前的河；

en.text: It turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrise to the border of Chisloth Tabor. It went out to Daberath, and went up to Japhia.

zhSimplified.text: 又从撒立往东转向日出之地，到吉斯绿·他泊的境界，又通到大比拉，上到雅非亚；

zhTraditional.text: 又從撒立往東轉向日出之地，到吉斯綠‧他泊的境界，又通到大比拉，上到雅非亞；

en.text: From there it passed along eastward to Gath Hepher, to Ethkazin; and it went out at Rimmon which stretches to Neah.

zhSimplified.text: 从那里往东，接连到迦特·希弗，至以特·加汛，通到临门，临门延到尼亚；

zhTraditional.text: 從那裏往東，接連到迦特‧希弗，至以特‧加汛，通到臨門，臨門延到尼亞；

en.text: The border turned around it on the north to Hannathon; and it ended at the valley of Iphtah El;

zhSimplified.text: 又绕过尼亚的北边，转到哈拿顿，通到伊弗他·伊勒谷。

zhTraditional.text: 又繞過尼亞的北邊，轉到哈拿頓，通到伊弗他‧伊勒谷。

en.text: Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.

zhSimplified.text: 还有加他、拿哈拉、伸 、以大拉、伯利恒，共十二座城，还有属城的村庄。

zhTraditional.text: 還有加他、拿哈拉、伸崙、以大拉、伯利恆，共十二座城，還有屬城的村莊。

en.text: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.

zhSimplified.text: 这些城并属城的村庄就是西布伦人按着宗族所得的地业。

zhTraditional.text: 這些城並屬城的村莊就是西布倫人按着宗族所得的地業。

en.text: The fourth lot came out for Issachar, even for the children of Issachar according to their families.

zhSimplified.text: 为以萨迦人，按着宗族，拈出第四阄。

zhTraditional.text: 為以薩迦人，按着宗族，拈出第四鬮。

en.text: Their border was to Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,

zhSimplified.text: 他们的境界是到耶斯列、基苏律、书念、

zhTraditional.text: 他們的境界是到耶斯列、基蘇律、書念、

en.text: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,

zhSimplified.text: 哈弗连、示按、亚拿哈拉、

zhTraditional.text: 哈弗連、示按、亞拿哈拉、

en.text: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,

zhSimplified.text: 拉璧、基善、亚别、

zhTraditional.text: 拉璧、基善、亞別、

en.text: Remeth, Engannim, En Haddah, and Beth Pazzez.

zhSimplified.text: 利篾、隐·干宁、隐·哈大、伯·帕薛；

zhTraditional.text: 利篾、隱‧干寧、隱‧哈大、伯‧帕薛；

en.text: The border reached to Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth Shemesh. Their border ended at the Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.

zhSimplified.text: 又达到他泊、沙哈洗玛、伯·示麦，直通到约旦河为止，共十六座城，还有属城的村庄。

zhTraditional.text: 又達到他泊、沙哈洗瑪、伯‧示麥，直通到約旦河為止，共十六座城，還有屬城的村莊。

en.text: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities with their villages.

zhSimplified.text: 这些城并属城的村庄就是以萨迦支派按着宗族所得的地业。

zhTraditional.text: 這些城並屬城的村莊就是以薩迦支派按着宗族所得的地業。

en.text: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.

zhSimplified.text: 为亚设支派，按着宗族，拈出第五阄。

zhTraditional.text: 為亞設支派，按着宗族，拈出第五鬮。

en.text: Their border was Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,

zhSimplified.text: 他们的境界是黑甲、哈利、比田、押煞、

zhTraditional.text: 他們的境界是黑甲、哈利、比田、押煞、

en.text: Allammelech, Amad, Mishal. It reached to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath.

zhSimplified.text: 亚拉米勒、亚末、米沙勒；往西达到迦密，又到希曷·立纳，

zhTraditional.text: 亞拉米勒、亞末、米沙勒；往西達到迦密，又到希曷‧立納，

en.text: It turned toward the sunrise to Beth Dagon, and reached to Zebulun, and to the valley of Iphtah El northward to Beth Emek and Neiel. It went out to Cabul on the left hand,

zhSimplified.text: 转向日出之地，到伯·大衮，达到细步纶；往北到伊弗他·伊勒谷，到伯·以墨和尼业，也通到迦步勒的左边；

zhTraditional.text: 轉向日出之地，到伯‧大袞，達到細步綸；往北到伊弗他‧伊勒谷，到伯‧以墨和尼業，也通到迦步勒的左邊；

en.text: and Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, even to great Sidon.

zhSimplified.text: 又到义伯 、利合、哈们、加拿，直到西顿大城；

zhTraditional.text: 又到義伯崙、利合、哈們、加拿，直到西頓大城；

en.text: The border turned to Ramah, to the fortified city of Tyre; and the border turned to Hosah. It ended at the sea by the region of Achzib;

zhSimplified.text: 转到拉玛和坚固城泰尔；又转到何萨，靠近亚革悉一带地方，直通到海；

zhTraditional.text: 轉到拉瑪和堅固城泰爾；又轉到何薩，靠近亞革悉一帶地方，直通到海；

en.text: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty-two cities with their villages.

zhSimplified.text: 又有乌玛、亚弗、利合，共二十二座城，还有属城的村庄。

zhTraditional.text: 又有烏瑪、亞弗、利合，共二十二座城，還有屬城的村莊。

en.text: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.

zhSimplified.text: 这些城并属城的村庄就是亚设支派按着宗族所得的地业。

zhTraditional.text: 這些城並屬城的村莊就是亞設支派按着宗族所得的地業。

en.text: The sixth lot came out for the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.

zhSimplified.text: 为拿弗他利人，按着宗族，拈出第六阄。

zhTraditional.text: 為拿弗他利人，按着宗族，拈出第六鬮。

en.text: Their border was from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, Adami-nekeb, and Jabneel, to Lakkum. It ended at the Jordan.

zhSimplified.text: 他们的境界是从希利弗从撒拿音的橡树，从亚大米·尼吉和雅比聂，直到拉共，通到约旦河；

zhTraditional.text: 他們的境界是從希利弗從撒拿音的橡樹，從亞大米‧尼吉和雅比聶，直到拉共，通到約旦河；

en.text: The border turned westward to Aznoth Tabor, and went out from there to Hukkok. It reached to Zebulun on the south, and reached to Asher on the west, and to Judah at the Jordan toward the sunrise.

zhSimplified.text: 又转向西到亚斯纳·他泊，从那里通到户割，南边到西布伦，西边到亚设，又向日出之地，达到约旦河那里的犹大。

zhTraditional.text: 又轉向西到亞斯納‧他泊，從那裏通到戶割，南邊到西布倫，西邊到亞設，又向日出之地，達到約旦河那裏的猶大。

en.text: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth,

zhSimplified.text: 坚固的城就是：西丁、侧耳、哈末、拉甲、基尼烈、

zhTraditional.text: 堅固的城就是：西丁、側耳、哈末、拉甲、基尼烈、

en.text: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,

zhSimplified.text: 亚大玛、拉玛、夏琐、

zhTraditional.text: 亞大瑪、拉瑪、夏瑣、

en.text: Kedesh, Edrei, En Hazor,

zhSimplified.text: 基低斯、以得来、隐·夏琐、

zhTraditional.text: 基低斯、以得來、隱‧夏瑣、

en.text: Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath, and Beth Shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.

zhSimplified.text: 以利稳、密大·伊勒、和琏、伯·亚纳、伯·示麦，共十九座城，还有属城的村庄。

zhTraditional.text: 以利穩、密大‧伊勒、和璉、伯‧亞納、伯‧示麥，共十九座城，還有屬城的村莊。

en.text: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities with their villages.

zhSimplified.text: 这些城并属城的村庄就是拿弗他利支派按着宗族所得的地业。

zhTraditional.text: 這些城並屬城的村莊就是拿弗他利支派按着宗族所得的地業。

en.text: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.

zhSimplified.text: 为但支派，按着宗族，拈出第七阄。

zhTraditional.text: 為但支派，按着宗族，拈出第七鬮。

en.text: The border of their inheritance was Zorah, Eshtaol, Irshemesh,

zhSimplified.text: 他们地业的境界是琐拉、以实陶、伊珥·示麦、

zhTraditional.text: 他們地業的境界是瑣拉、以實陶、伊珥‧示麥、

en.text: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,

zhSimplified.text: 沙拉宾、亚雅 、伊提拉、

zhTraditional.text: 沙拉賓、亞雅崙、伊提拉、

en.text: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,

zhSimplified.text: 以伦、亭拿他、以革伦、

zhTraditional.text: 以倫、亭拿他、以革倫、

en.text: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,

zhSimplified.text: 伊利提基、基比顿、巴拉、

zhTraditional.text: 伊利提基、基比頓、巴拉、

en.text: Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimmon,

zhSimplified.text: 伊胡得、比尼·比拉、迦特·临门、

zhTraditional.text: 伊胡得、比尼‧比拉、迦特‧臨門、

en.text: Me Jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border opposite Joppa.

zhSimplified.text: 美·耶昆、拉昆，并约帕对面的地界。

zhTraditional.text: 美‧耶昆、拉昆，並約帕對面的地界。

en.text: The border of the children of Dan went out beyond them; for the children of Dan went up and fought against Leshem, and took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and lived therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their forefather.

zhSimplified.text: 但人的地界越过原得的地界；因为但人上去攻取利善，用刀击杀城中的人，得了那城，住在其中，以他们先祖但的名将利善改名为但。

zhTraditional.text: 但人的地界越過原得的地界；因為但人上去攻取利善，用刀擊殺城中的人，得了那城，住在其中，以他們先祖但的名將利善改名為但。

en.text: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.

zhSimplified.text: 这些城并属城的村庄就是但支派按着宗族所得的地业。

zhTraditional.text: 這些城並屬城的村莊就是但支派按着宗族所得的地業。

en.text: So they finished distributing the land for inheritance by its borders. The children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列人按着境界分完了地业，就在他们中间将地给嫩的儿子约书亚为业，

zhTraditional.text: 以色列人按着境界分完了地業，就在他們中間將地給嫩的兒子約書亞為業，

en.text: According to the LORD’s commandment, they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnathserah in the hill country of Ephraim; and he built the city, and lived there.

zhSimplified.text: 是照耶和华的吩咐，将约书亚所求的城，就是以法莲山地的亭拿·西拉城，给了他。他就修那城，住在其中。

zhTraditional.text: 是照耶和華的吩咐，將約書亞所求的城，就是以法蓮山地的亭拿‧西拉城，給了他。他就修那城，住在其中。

en.text: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the LORD, at the door of the Tent of Meeting. So they finished dividing the land.

zhSimplified.text: 这就是祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚，并以色列各支派的族长，在示罗会幕门口，耶和华面前，拈阄所分的地业。这样，他们把地分完了。

zhTraditional.text: 這就是祭司以利亞撒和嫩的兒子約書亞，並以色列各支派的族長，在示羅會幕門口，耶和華面前，拈鬮所分的地業。這樣，他們把地分完了。
